info.title: Lumina API
info.description:
Backend for Lumina — visual & audio affirmations that turn mindset into real-world impact.

**Authentication:** Google OpenID Connect. Browsers start at `GET /auth/google/start`; the API sets an HttpOnly session cookie. **CSRF:** every unsafe request needs `X-CSRF-Token` and an allowed `Origin`. **Errors:** RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`. **Rate limits:** `RateLimit-*` response headers.

sessionCookie.name: lumina_session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque, HttpOnly session cookie set after Google sign-in (`__Host-lumina_session` in production). State-changing requests must also send `X-CSRF-Token` (from `GET /auth/session`) and come from an allowed Origin.

csrfToken.description: Send as the X-CSRF-Token header on every POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE.

practiced.description: Whether the signed-in user already practised today's action.

LocalDate.description: Calendar date in the user's time zone.

Palette.description: Atmosphere & colour field of a visual mantra card.

Mood.description: Prevailing inner state for a journal check-in.

regularity.description: Percent of the last 30 days with a check-in.

get.description: Starts an OpenID Connect authorization-code flow with PKCE (S256), `state` and `nonce`, stored in an encrypted, short-lived HttpOnly cookie. Redirects the browser to Google. First-time users are registered automatically.

schema.description: Relative app path to return to.

parameters.description: Relative app path to return to.
parameters.name: returnTo

get.description: Validates `state`, exchanges the code (with the PKCE verifier), verifies the ID token signature, issuer, audience, nonce and `email_verified`, creates or links the account, sets the session cookie, then redirects to the web app. On failure redirects to `/login?error=<code>`.

302.description: Redirect back to the web app.

post.description: Only available when `DEV_LOGIN_ENABLED=1` and `NODE_ENV` is not production. Returns 404 otherwise.
